{{Quote|First item of business is your detonator, sir: a Czerka Arms 53-R high-yield thermite explosive. Guaranteed to get a party started&mdash;or ended.|Mathin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''53-R high-yield thermite explosive''' was a type of [[Thermite/Legends|thermite]] explosive produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]]. [[Havoc Squad]] used one to destroy a comm relay in [[The Works/Legends|the Works]].
